Long agent lines can visibly wrap across multiple rows, while visual highlight/cursor movement/copy operate on the unwrapped logical line, so selected text can differ from what is highlighted. - `src/terminal_app.rs:366` rebuilds pending completion prompts by scanning every historical session line, and `src/terminal_app.rs:805` rearms whenever it sees `FEATURE_DONE_PROMPT`.
